div.div: أَسَاهِىُّ , (JK, TA,) in the K, erroneously, ↓ أَسْهَآء , (TA,) i. q. أَلْوَانٌ [generally signifying Colours; but also meaning sorts, or species; and here used in this latter sense, as is indicated in the TA]: a pl. having no sing.: (K, TA:) so in the M: (TA:) or it signifies, (JK,) or signifies also, (TA,) various sorts (ضُرُوبٌ مُخْتَلِفةٌ, JK, TA) of pace of camels; like أَسَاهِيجُ: (TA:) and its sing. is ↓ أَسْهَآءَةٌ . (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
